messages:
maria: FYI customer-prod (acct 987654321) hit a spike of 403s on decrypt after our KMS alias swap last night. They report ~95% of requests failing with AccessDeniedException. CloudTrail for their service shows no Decrypt events around error times.
ken: Can you paste the exact error and the CLI/SDK call they used? Also which alias->key change did we push?
maria: Error from their service: `AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-...` They call `Decrypt` on ciphertext produced by our GenerateDataKey (we sent them the ciphertext blob). We rotated the alias `alias/redwood-shared` to point to new HSM-backed key ARN `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/1234-...` at 2026-03-08T03:10Z.
irene: Two quick suspects: 1) cross-account grant/policy not applied to the new key 2) encryption-context mismatch if they re-encrypted locally. Can they share the ciphertext header or the encryptionContext used?
maria: They shared this repro CLI: ```aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --encryption-context Application=storage --profile customer-prod``` They say the encryption-context they used matches what we expect.
ken: If alias pointed to a new key id, existing grants referencing the old key id won't cover the new key. List grants on the new key: `aws kms list-grants --key-id 1234-...` If empty, that's likely it. Also check key policy includes the role/arn for their account or the service principal.
sam: CloudTrail absence is interesting — if their requests never reached KMS (403 IAM before calling) you wouldn't see Decrypt events. Check CloudTrail for `kms:Decrypt` vs `kms:DecryptResponse` and also `AssumeRole` events for the call. May be their IAM role doesn't have sts:AssumeRole->kms:Decrypt mapping after rotation.
maria: I ran `aws kms list-grants` on the new key and got nothing. The old key still has the cross-account grant with `GranteePrincipal` set to `arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/redwood-cust-role`. The alias change happened without recreating grants.
ken: Oof — we should've propagated grants. Grants are key-specific, not alias-wide. Short-term mitigation: roll the alias back to the old key id while we create the appropriate grants on the new key. Longer-term: add grant creation into the alias promotion workflow.
irene: Also validate key policy: `kms:CreateGrant` must be allowed to the principal that runs our rotation job; otherwise we can't create grants on the new key programmatically. If rotation job used a different principal, grant creation may have silently failed.
maria: For the customer, recommended immediate steps: 1) rollback alias to previous key (we can do this now) 2) once traffic stabilizes, create grants on the new key: `aws kms create-grant --key-id 1234-... --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::987654321:role/redwood-cust-role --operations Decrypt,Encrypt,ReEncrypt* --name "cross-account-grant-987654321"` 3) verify `list-grants` returns the grant id and test decryption.
ken: Also ensure the grant's constraints (encryptionContextSubset) match their usage. If we created a grant with constraints, and their encryption context differs, Decrypt will fail despite grant presence.
sam: For audit: we need to add a CloudTrail check to detect alias->key mappings with missing grants. Suggest a daily job: for each alias change, compare `ListGrants` of the new key for expected principals. Alert if missing.
maria: Customer asked about data residency/audit — they want full CloudTrail evidence we attempted decryption. We'll provide timeline and note: no Decrypt events recorded because their role was denied pre-KMS. We'll include the `list-grants` snapshots and our alias change event.
ken: I'll own the remediation to create the grants and add rotation workflow fix. @irene please check the rotation job's permissions and whether it attempted grant creation and failed.
irene: On it. Initial check: rotation runner role didn't include `kms:CreateGrant` for new HSM keys. I'll up-permission in the rotation job and add retry+logging for grant creation.
maria: Customer blocked for now, but rollback + grant create should restore. I've scheduled a rolling rollback at 03:40Z (in 20m) as a mitigation and notified CS.
kms-bot: Deploy log: alias update rollback requested by maria at 1932101360, status: queued. :gear:
ken: After rollback and grant creation, test with customer using a small sample ciphertext to confirm `Decrypt` succeeds. If their clients cached key id, they may need to re-fetch alias resolution (SDK caches). Recommend they clear any local cache or re-init SDK client.
maria: Thanks — I'll keep thread updated. Will attach `aws cli` outputs and CloudTrail snippets after rollback. :thumbsup:
